points.label: Surrounding figures
points.left: The scene includes a voice at baptism, the Spirit’s driving action, and forty days. It also includes Satan, wild animals, and serving angels. Together, these details are held in a short sequence.
points.right: The Spirit leads Jesus, the tempter speaks, Scripture is quoted and answered, Satan is named, and angels serve after the devil leaves.

payload.posture: Read both WEBU passages side by side. Keep each passage’s actors, setting, order, and identity claims distinct.

rightEvidence.title: Matthew narrates three exchanges and Scripture responses

payload.tension: Mark tells the wilderness scene briefly. Matthew adds the devil’s words and Jesus’ answers.
